verses.mystical_translation: Even heavenly-sounding authority is judged by how it treats the weak.
The poem enters through divine council, elohim, unjust judgment, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when fear, power, memory, and relationship are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.

safety_note: The psalm’s target is corrupt power. “Gods” language must not be used to dehumanize people or claim unquestionable authority for leaders.
